notes: BlackRock's FY2024 10-K gives employees only as regional shares (Americas 43%, EMEA 31%, Asia-Pacific 26% of ~21,100) and says it has employees in more than 30 countries; no headcounts by country or state, and no regional headcounts are derived. Item 2 lists the leased HQ (50 Hudson Yards), an owned Wilmington, DE office building, an owned Amherst, NY data center, and leased offices including Atlanta, Belgrade, Budapest, Edinburgh, Gurgaon, Hong Kong, London, Mumbai, Princeton, San Francisco and Singapore; Belgrade and Edinburgh are left out of sites only because of the 12-site cap. No company economic-impact or taxes-by-country report was found.
